---
name: ✨ Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for KeyDeck
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'needs-triage']
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

---

## 💡 Problem Statement

**What problem does this feature solve?**

Describe the problem or limitation you're experiencing that this feature would address.

---

## 🎯 Proposed Solution

**How would you like this feature to work?**

Describe your ideal solution in detail. Include:
- User interface changes (if applicable)
- Workflow or process changes
- Expected behavior

---

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions

**Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?**

Describe any alternative approaches you've thought about or tried.

---

## 📊 Use Case

**When would you use this feature?**

Describe specific scenarios or use cases where this feature would be helpful.

Example:
- As a developer managing multiple Redis instances...
- When analyzing production Redis data...
- While troubleshooting connection issues...

---

## 🎨 Mockups or Examples

If applicable, add:
- Screenshots from other tools that have similar features
- Mockups or wireframes
- Code examples showing how you'd like to use it

---

## 📈 Impact

**Who would benefit from this feature?**

- [ ] All users
- [ ] Developers working with Redis
- [ ] DevOps/Infrastructure teams
- [ ] Enterprise users
- [ ] Specific use case: ___________

**Priority (from your perspective):**
- [ ] Critical - Can't use KeyDeck effectively without it
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Optional enhancement

---

## 🛠️ Technical Considerations

**Do you have any technical insights or suggestions?**

If you're familiar with the codebase or have implementation ideas, share them here:
- Potential libraries or APIs that could help
- Technical challenges you foresee
- Performance considerations

---

## 📚 Related Features

**Are there related features or enhancements?**

- Related to existing feature: ___________
- Depends on: #___________
- Blocks: #___________

---

## 🌍 Additional Context

Add any other context, links, or information about the feature request here.

---

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I have checked existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have clearly described the problem this feature solves
- [ ] I have provided use cases and examples
- [ ] I am willing to contribute to implementing this feature (optional)
